description: Metadata for confirmed public Center for AI and Digital Policy research, publication, and policy pages on www.caidp.org. caidp.org redirects to that host. Each URL was confirmed by one bounded GET. Login pages, challenges, robots disallows, and off-host redirects are omitted. Rows keep a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies, abstracts, quotes, transcripts, and chart data are omitted. A sole CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, or CC BY-NC-ND keeps its own token. CC BY alone is creative_commons_attribution. CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those is creative_commons. Mixed licences stay unknown. uk_ogl requires the phrase Open Government Licence. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not dates. This catalog is not a belief collector and runner_wired is false.
